summary: A Depth subscription on a perpetual: the book before any ticker goes out as Delta sent it; a ticker after it sends the book again with the mark price, OHLC, OI and the best bid and ask (audit P-07).

deviations.reason: A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the symbol's first ticker; the web's merged cache has no ltp until a ticker came.

The web pads a short side of Delta's book to five zero levels Delta never sent and gives them no order count; the desktop sends the levels Delta sent (lead rule on book levels: padding a web adapter adds is a web defect).
Delta's ticker carries no average price; the web sends a constant 0 (_normalise_ticker's defaults). The docs say leave out a field the stream does not carry, as the desktop does.
The web sends a constant oi_change of 0 on every ticker (_normalise_ticker's defaults) whatever Delta sent; a value the desktop does not know is left out.
